ability.name: Droth-helm
ability.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for **Companion** weapons used by friendly **^^Fyreslayers^^** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

ability.name: Draught of the Finest Magmalt
ability.effect: Add 3 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Ash-cloud Rune
ability.effect: Until the start of your next turn, friendly **^^Infantry^^** units cannot be targeted by shooting attacks while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.
